lessons.title: Is + slí bheatha + é/í
lessons.rule: To say what job someone does, put Is first, then the job, then é for a man or í for a woman: Is múinteoir í.
steps: Read the question: aici (at her) tells you it is about a woman.
Start with Is and add the job: Is réiteoir.
End with í because she is a woman: Is réiteoir í.

example.prompt: Cad é an obair atá aici? (réiteoir)
example.answer: Cad é an obair atá aici? Is réiteoir í.

more.prompt: Cad é an obair atá aige? (póilín)
more.answer: Cad é an obair atá aige? Is póilín é.

more.prompt: Cad é an obair atá aici? (ríomhchláraitheoir)
more.answer: Cad é an obair atá aici? Is ríomhchláraitheoir í.

lessons.hint: Is + job + é for a man, í for a woman.

lessons.title: An maith leat ...? Is maith liom
lessons.rule: Answer An maith leat ...? with the copula, never with tá: Is maith liom for yes, Ní maith liom for no. The question says leat (you), your answer says liom (me).
steps: Read the question: An maith leat rapcheol?
Choose Is for yes or Ní for no: Is.
Keep maith and change leat to liom: Is maith liom.

example.answer: An maith leat rapcheol? Is maith liom.

more.answer: An maith leat bachlóga Bhruiséile? Ní maith liom.

more.prompt: An maith leat an físeán sin?
more.answer: An maith leat an físeán sin? Is breá liom.

lessons.hint: Is maith liom (yes) or Ní maith liom (no): leat becomes liom.

lessons.title: Cé acu is fearr leat?
lessons.rule: To answer Cé acu is fearr leat X nó Y?, say Is fearr liom and name the one you like better.
steps: Find the two choices on each side of nó: rapcheol, popcheol.
Pick one: rapcheol.
Start with Is fearr liom and add your choice: Is fearr liom rapcheol.

lessons.title: Sílim gur ...
lessons.rule: After sílim (I think), Is changes to gur: Is feirmeoir é becomes Sílim gur feirmeoir é.
steps: Read the clues and decide on the job: she works in a school and corrects homework, so múinteoir.
Make the plain sentence: Is múinteoir í.
Put Sílim in front and change Is to gur: Sílim gur múinteoir í.

lessons.title: Nach deas an ... é?
lessons.rule: Put Nach first, then the adjective, then an + noun, then é (or í if the prompt shows í, for a feminine noun). Answer with Is and the adjective only: Is deas.
steps: Start with Nach and the adjective: Nach deas.
Add an and the noun: Nach deas an fón.
End with é, because fón is masculine: Nach deas an fón é?
Answer with Is and the adjective: Is deas.

example.answer: Nach deas an fón é? Is deas.

more.answer: Nach uafásach an timpiste í? Is uafásach.

lessons.hint: Nach + adjective + an + noun + é/í? Answer: Is + adjective.

lessons.title: Ba san aimsir chaite
lessons.rule: In the past, use Ba instead of Is, and add h after the first letter of the adjective: mór becomes Ba mhór. Adjectives beginning with l, n, r or sp do not change.
steps: Start with Ba.
Add h after the first letter of the adjective: cumasach becomes chumasach.
Add an + noun and é: Ba chumasach an peileadóir é.
lessons.hint: Ba + h after the first letter of the adjective.

items.prompt: rang/leadránach
items.answer: Ba leadránach an rang é.

items.answer: Ba spórtúil an gasúr é.

lessons.title: B' roimh ghuta
lessons.en: The past: B' before a vowel
lessons.rule: If the adjective begins with a vowel, Ba becomes B' and is joined to it: B'iontach.
steps: Check the first letter of the adjective: uafásach begins with a vowel.
Write B' joined to the adjective: B'uafásach.
Add an + noun and í, because the prompt shows í: B'uafásach an oíche í.
lessons.hint: Vowel at the start of the adjective: B' + adjective.

items.prompt: aip í/amaideach
items.answer: B'amaideach an aip í.

items.prompt: turas/aoibhinn
items.answer: B'aoibhinn an turas é.

items.prompt: cluiche/iontach
items.answer: B'iontach an cluiche é.

items.prompt: scéal/olc
items.answer: B'olc an scéal é.
